scope: One isolated namespace on the lab's pinned Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind cluster. Paired server-side dry-runs compare absent emptyDir sizeLimit and absent regular-container ephemeral-storage declarations before and after a case-owned ValidatingAdmissionPolicy. ResourceQuota admission is checked for aggregate declared requests and limits. One tiny marker is read below its bound. A second workload writes only 128 KiB against a 64 KiB disk-backed emptyDir bound to observe kubelet eviction on the test filesystem. Production filesystem and training workload behavior require deployment evidence.

checks.claim: Without case policy or quota, the API admits each bounded candidate
The policy rejects missing scratch bounds and preserves valid, over-budget declarations for quota evaluation
